params.name: content_type_id
params.description: Django content type ID for the placeholder's owner model

params.name: object_id
params.description: Primary key of the placeholder's owner object

params.name: preview
params.description: Set to 1 or true to include draft/unpublished content (requires appropriate permissions)

params.name: html
params.description: Set to 1 to include server-rendered HTML for placeholder content

items.docs: Retrieve the content of a placeholder by content type, object ID, and slot name. The response includes the nested plugin data as structured JSON. Add ?html=1 to also receive server-rendered HTML output.
